chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ubayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If they are seven on Friday, then let them pray in congregation.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number mentioned for performing the Friday prayer in congregation according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the minimum number relevant to Friday congregational prayer. It indicates that when seven people are present on Friday, they should perform the prayer in congregation.
